input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for employee client, department, employee. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to interact with department functionality, so that I can accomplish my department-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with employee functionality, so that I can accomplish my employee-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with organization functionality, so that I can accomplish my organization-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to use employee client capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to use department capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
